SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_heroes,
       COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS nonnull_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(s.weight_kg) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg = -99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minus_99_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_weights,
       MIN(s.weight_kg) AS minimum_weight
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
